benchmark_exclusion_policy: No example from the 600-case DeepShield-RAG benchmark may be used to train, validate, select, or tune the risk classifier. Exact hashes, normalized text, template families, and near-duplicate clusters must be checked before a classifier dataset is frozen.

sources.citation: jackhhao. Jailbreak Classification dataset. Hugging Face, revision 2f2ceeb39658696fd3f462403562b6eea5306287.
limitations: The source targets jailbreak detection rather than every DeepShield-RAG threat category.
The upstream files do not provide family IDs, so deterministic near-duplicate clustering is required before any project split.
Upstream labels and source provenance require sampling and human review before the derived dataset can be frozen.

sources.citation: Sharma, Gupta, and Grossman. SPML: A DSL for Defending Language Models Against Prompt Attacks. arXiv:2402.11755, 2024.
limitations: The dataset authors caution that its limited attack techniques should not be treated as a standalone detector-training source.
Examples depend on paired system-prompt context, while the first lightweight classifier will screen user or retrieved text independently.
The source is reserved for external stress testing and must never enter development partitions.
